runs.pr_body:
## median_cents in ledgerlite/stats.py returns the wrong value for even-length amount lists instead of averaging the two middle values as its docstring specifies.

Closes: Fix median_cents for even-length amount lists

### Plan
- Inspect median_cents in ledgerlite/stats.py to find the even-count indexing error
- Fix median_cents so even-length inputs return the average of the two middle values (e.g. (200 + 300) / 2 = 250), preserving odd-count behavior
- Add a regression test in tests/test_stats_regression.py covering median_cents([100, 200, 300, 400]) == 250 and an odd-count case
- Run the regression test and all existing tests to verify everything passes

### Files changed
- ledgerlite/stats.py
- tests/test_stats_regression.py

### Tests
All tests pass (9 → 11 discovered).

### Regression gate
Verified: suite fails on baseline production code, so the new tests demonstrate the claimed change.

### Issue-target gate
Verified: the fix changes the issue's named target(s): median_cents.

### Reviewer
approve: Checked diff limited to median_cents in ledgerlite/stats.py plus new tests/test_stats_regression.py; tests pass (11 vs 9 before), regression gate fails on baseline and passes after, target gate matches median_cents; even-count averaging and odd-count regression tests cover the fix; no unrelated changes or risks found.

diff --git a/ledgerlite/stats.py b/ledgerlite/stats.py
index 653bddb..b098585 100644
--- a/ledgerlite/stats.py
+++ b/ledgerlite/stats.py
@@ -22,4 +22,4 @@ def median_cents(values):
     mid = n // 2
     if n % 2 == 1:
         return ordered[mid]
-    return ordered[mid]  # BUG: even count must average ordered[mid-1] and ordered[mid]
+    return (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2

--- new file: tests/test_stats_regression.py ---
+import unittest
+
+from ledgerlite.stats import median_cents
+
+
+class TestMedianCentsRegression(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_even_count_averages_two_middle_values(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median_cents([100, 200, 300, 400]), 250)
+
+    def test_odd_count_returns_middle_value(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median_cents([100, 200, 300]), 200)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
